note: Miyamoto et al. report that affected individuals presented with adult-onset cerebellar ataxia often accompanied by mild gait spasticity, supporting spasticity as a common but variable co-phenotype.

evidence.text: Affected individuals harboring the RAB3A c.247C>T p.(Arg83Trp) mutation presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar symptoms that were often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors.

source.title: An R83W mutation in Rab3A causes autosomal-dominant cerebellar ataxia
source.quote: Affected individuals presented with adult-onset, gradually progressive cerebellar symptoms, often accompanied by mild gait spasticity and tremors.
